meta.name: Ochre Forge Milestone Relic
meta.description: Forged in the heart of The Grand Crucible of the Tectonic Leviathan by the illustrious Ochre Toad, this milestone trophy resonates with the deeply buried Ochre Stratum. By grounding subterranean plasma with hyper-dense alloys, it channels excess energy back to the user, significantly easing the durability drain on tools while deep in the Brass Ledger Frontier.
meta.author: jules
